report:
Freshly reviewed the current claim, both ordinary implementation entries, and all eight ordinary test entries from the new start inputs. No TODO/N/A evidence exists. The complete requirements are rooted semantic equality, deterministic structural fingerprints, fingerprint-based equality/ordering/hashing/Salsa updates, and independence from addresses, allocation order, padding, and unreachable allocations.

Current implementation: Stashed::new hashes only root through FingerprintHasher and saves the result with the owned stash. Current additional checking/signature anchor comments beside the constructor do not change this behavior. PartialEq compares fingerprints, Hash hashes the fingerprint, Ord compares it, and PartialOrd delegates to Ord. Salsa Update compares Stashed values and returns false without replacement for equal fingerprints; otherwise it assigns the new value and returns true. Pointer hashing follows the typed referent; slice hashing follows length and elements in logical order. The per-entry cache stores only computed content fingerprints and does not feed entry indices or stash identity into the digest. Xxh3 is freshly initialized, and finalize uses its 128-bit digest. Option hashes a discriminant and content; scalar/direct types delegate to value Hash. These dependencies and allocation/read helpers are in the captured full implementation file. Derived struct hashing traverses fields rather than raw memory; derived enums hash variant index and fields. Both generators and all helpers are in the second associated implementation file. Padding and unreachable allocations never enter the traversal. No additional essential implementation file requires association.

Every associated test was inspected. fingerprint_deterministic compares equivalent Points allocated in separate stashes. stashed_eq_compound_dag checks a shared leaf through two Option pointers. stashed_hash_consistent_with_eq asserts equal values and hashes. stashed_ne_different_content_fingerprint asserts different field values are unequal. stashed_ord_consistent_with_eq checks Equal ordering for equal content. reachable_content_controls_equality_hash_and_order varies reversed allocation order and unrelated allocations in all four combinations, directly asserts equality/hash/order consistency for unchanged content, then inequality, non-equal order, comparison reversal, and stable ordering for changed content. Captured tree helper constructs padded referents and a slice root [a,b,a], so this covers pointer recursion, ordered slice traversal, shared-entry caching, and garbage both before and after the root. padded_values_fingerprint_only_semantic_fields first verifies the fixture has padding, then compares derived hashing with explicitly hashing just tag and value. salsa_update_keeps_equal_root_and_replaces_changed_root, gated on feature salsa, directly checks false and original-root retention for equivalent content with changed layout, then true and replacement for different content, and dereferences the replacement to assert value 21. Point, Padded, tree, and hash fixture definitions were captured with review read. Tests would detect a switch to address/index/buffer hashing, raw padded hashing, inconsistent ordering/hashing, or incorrect Salsa replacement decisions.

This is a fresh source assessment, not reliance on a prior verdict. No tests were executed in this refresh: the coordinator is running the suites centrally, as specified in captured instructions. No source changes or unrecorded helper dependencies were used. All stated requirements have implementation and meaningful test evidence; no requested edits.
